query:
UPDATE recording_sessions rs
            SET state = 'finalized',
                ended_at = to_timestamp($2::double precision / 1000.0),
                end_reason = 'fragment_setup_failed',
                updated_at = now()
          WHERE rs.id = $1
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                  FROM audio_files af
                 WHERE af.recording_session_id = rs.id
                   AND af.end_ts IS NOT NULL
                   AND af.reaped IS FALSE
            )
